title: License plates
about: Plates give you the COUNTRY (location points) and often the ERA: EU blue band (1990s+), font changes, colour schemes and number formats. Quiz images come from each country's Wikipedia plate article (current and historic plates).

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the United Kingdom
items.now: AB12 CDE (2001+), white front / yellow rear
items.tell: Yellow rear plate; age identifier in digits 2001+; before 2001 a prefix letter (A123 BCD, 1983–2001) or suffix letter (ABC 123A, 1963–83); black-and-silver plates before 1973

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the Republic of Ireland
items.tell: Starts with year digits (87-D-… since 1987; 3-digit 131/132 since 2013); county letters; 'Éire' on band
Right blue band with region logo + department number; before 2009 '1234 AB 75' (dept at end); rear plates yellow until 1993
City code + 1–2 letters + numbers; round seals between; FE-Schrift font since 2000; EU band since mid-1990s

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the Netherlands
items.tell: Yellow both sides since 1978 (before: dark blue with white chars); hyphen groups
Red/burgundy text; before 2010 also red on white (ABC-123)
Yellow plates, very short numbers
Since Sept 2000 national 4 digits + 3 consonants (sequential, letters tell the year: BBB=2000, LLL≈2020); before 2000 provincial 'M-1234-AB'
Pairs separated by dashes; yellow strip with year/month on the right (1998–2005)

items.now: AB 123 CD (1994+), blue bands both sides (1999+)
items.tell: Before 1994: province code (MI, ROMA) + number, black plates before 1985
Non-EU: no blue band; small rear plate format; canton coat of arms

items.now: W 12345 A, red-white-red stripes top and bottom
items.tell: Red-white-red border stripes (1990+); black plates with white text before 1990
White with red frame; yellow plates = commercial vans
3 letters + 3 chars, EU band; black text on white since 1973 (black plates with white text before)

items.now: AB 12345, EU-like band with Norwegian flag
items.tell: Two letters + five digits; EL/EK/EV/EB… = electric (very common 2015+)
Three letters + dash + 1–3 digits; black frame line

items.now: AB 123 / AB A12 with blue border
items.tell: Small flag of Iceland on left
Region letters first (W=Warsaw, K=Kraków); black plates with white text until 2000

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the Czech Republic
items.tell: Digit-letter-digit then four digits; 'CZ' on band
District code + coat of arms + digits/letters
Three letters + dash + three digits for ~30 years
County code + 2 digits + 3 letters
Latin letters that also exist in Cyrillic (A B E K M H O P C T Y X)
Only Greek-Latin lookalike letters; three letters + four digits
Red-white checkerboard coat of arms between city and number
Non-EU blue band; city code + small shield
Green border and city coat of arms
Letter-3 digits-2 letters, region code in a box with Russian flag (1993+); black plates in Soviet times
Two letters + 4 digits + two letters; flag + UA
Four digits first, region digit after dash
Similar to Sweden; 'LT' band
Two letters dash up to 4 digits; 'LV'
Digits FIRST then letters; 'EST'
Province number first (34=Istanbul, 06=Ankara); blue 'TR' band

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the United States
items.tell: Small wide plates with state name and slogan; front plate absent in many states
US-size plates with province names (e.g. 'Je me souviens' = Québec)
US-size; state name on top
Grey plate 'ABC-1234' with city name (1990–2018); yellow plates before 1990
Black plate with white 'ABC 123' (1995–2016)
Four letters + two digits with Chilean shield (2007+)
Yellow plates with black text and city at bottom
Blue top band with 'PERÚ'
Mercosur blue band with Uruguay flag
White/green = private, yellow/black = kei car (since 1975), green/white = commercial

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of South Korea
items.tell: Hangul syllable in the middle; long EU-size since 2006; blue EV plates (2017+)
One Chinese character (province) + letter; blue plate white text; yellow for big vehicles
White with black text, small 'Taiwan' label

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of Hong Kong
items.tell: UK-style white front / yellow rear, left-hand traffic, no EU band
State code + district number; white private, yellow commercial, green EV
Thai letters with province underneath; often decorative backgrounds
Black plates with white text for decades, region letter first

items.now: Black with white text, e.g. WXY 1234
items.tell: Black plates, state letter prefix

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of the Philippines
items.tell: White with Rizal monument (2014+); green on white earlier
Province number first; tons of scooters
US-size-ish plates with state slogans ('Sunshine State' = QLD)

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of New Zealand
items.tell: White with black text; dealer frame at bottom

items.w: Vehicle registration plates of South Africa
items.tell: Colourful provincial backgrounds
Yellow plates, digits only, 'IL' band

items.now: Arabic letters + numerals, coloured top band
items.tell: Eastern Arabic numerals, 'مصر EGYPT' header
Number + Arabic letter + region number
